paragraphs.text: The shadewalkers are mysterious rogues from Ravnica who can turn themselves invisible. They are possibly associated with House Dimir .

Shadewalkers are small creatures with wiry bodies. They are wrapped loosely in blue, gauzy bandages. A pair of glowing eyes peek out through the face wrappings, and their arms are longer than is quite right, simian-like, and oddly double-jointed. They also have a smaller vestigial arm tipped with a clawed hand growing from their torso.
Some hired shadewalkers aided Evern Capobar in the retrieval of the cerebral fluid from a dragon for Momir Vig , but also sold some of it to the Cult of Rakdos .
